segments.an4.128:1.1: “Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavanti.
segments.an4.128:1.4: sā tathāgatena anālaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
segments.an4.128:1.5: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
segments.an4.128:2.2: Sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
segments.an4.128:2.3: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
segments.an4.128:3.2: Sā tathāgatena opasamike dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
segments.an4.128:3.3: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
segments.an4.128:4.2: Sā tathāgatena avijjāvinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati sotaṃ odahati aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
segments.an4.128:4.3: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
segments.an4.128:4.4: Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavantī”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame taṇhādiṭṭhīhi allīyitabbaṭṭhena ālayoti pañca kāmaguṇā, sakalameva vā vaṭṭaṃ.
Āramanti etthāti ārāmo, ālayo ārāmo etissāti ālayārāmā.
Upasamapaṭipakkho anupasamo, anupasantaṭṭhena vā vaṭṭameva anupasamo nāma.
Avijjāvinayeti avijjāvinayo vuccati arahattaṃ, taṃnissite dhamme desiyamāneti attho.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte catūsu ṭhānesu vaṭṭaṃ, catūsu vivaṭṭaṃ kathitaṃ. 9.
Aṭṭhame ālīyanti āramitabbaṭṭhena sevīyantīti ālayā, pañca kāmaguṇā.
Ālīyanti vā allīyantā abhiramaṇavasena sevantīti ālayā, taṇhāvicaritāni.

Yatheva hi susajjitaṃ pupphaphalabharitarukkhādisampannauyyānaṃ paviṭṭho rājā tāya sampattiyā ramati, sammudito āmoditappamodito hoti, na ukkaṇṭheti, sāyampi nikkhamituṃ na icchati, evamimehi kāmālayataṇhālayehi sattā ramanti, saṃsāravaṭṭe pamuditā anukkaṇṭhitā vasanti.
Tena tesaṃ bhagavā duvidhampi ālayaṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ viya dassento “ālayārāmā”tiādimāha.
